summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reprinted a New York Sun item that Steve Taylor and George Rooke, after trading blows on East Houston Street, made a $1,000-a-side match in the same ring where Joe Goss and Allen would meet.

notes: Only a passing mention of the coming Goss-Allen fight; no new facts about Allen.
